WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT ss."cds", ss."avgscrread"
    FROM "satscores" ss
    WHERE ss."avgscrread" IS NOT NULL

84:
WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname1") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname2") <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("admfname3") <> ''
),

name_counts AS (
    SELECT
        "first_name",
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        MIN("district") AS district
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "first_name"
)

SELECT
    "first_name",
    "district"
FROM name_counts
ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST, "first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 2;

    s."phone" AS phone_number
FROM schools s

WHERE

    (f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS "free_rate"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode

49:
WITH closed_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        s."school",
        s."closeddate"
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" LIKE '%Closed%'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cs."county",
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM closed_schools cs
    GROUP BY cs."county"
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT cc."county"
    FROM county_counts cc
    ORDER BY cc.cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    cs."school",
    cs."closeddate"
FROM closed_schools cs
JOIN top_county tc ON cs."county" = tc."county"
ORDER BY cs."closeddate" ASC NULLS FIRST;

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.fundingtype LIKE '%Locally%'
)

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode

WHERE s.fundingtype LIKE '%Locally%'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > a.avg_difference
